title: The Quiet Room
author: Gideon Marchetti
blurb: Ivo Nakamura, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
